name: Clinic Appointment & Intake
description: A light front-desk toolkit for a small clinic: register patients, manage providers, book and track appointments, capture patient intake and consent, and schedule follow-ups from one linked dashboard. Includes 5 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: Clinic Appointment & Intake
packMeta.description: A light front-desk toolkit for a small clinic: register patients, manage providers, book and track appointments, collect patient intake details and consent, and schedule follow-ups — all linked together on one dashboard. Administrative only; no diagnoses or treatment records.
